# SlurpIT

This mod adds the slurpit plugin to a netbox container.

Add it to the `netbox` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:netbox-slurpit
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:netbox-slurpit|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

Update your `configuration.py` to include the plugin

```
...
# Enable installed plugins. Add the name of each plugin to the list.
PLUGINS = ['slurpit_netbox']

...
```

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/netbox-slurpit/
